raw_segments.text: No, no, it wasn't. I said the corpusants have mercy on us all and I hope they will
still. But do they only have mercy on long faces? Have they no bowels for a laugh? And
look ye, Mr. Starbuck, but it's too dark to look. Hear me, then. I take that masthead
flame we saw for a sign of good luck, for those masts are rooted in a hole that is going
to be chalk a block with sperm oil, do you see? And so all that sperm will work up into
the masts, like sap in a tree. Yes, our three masts will yet be as three
spermaceti candles. That's the good promise we saw.
